package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"

	"gorm.io/driver/sqlite"
)

// scenario for gorm_open_per_request: gorm.Open(...) called on request paths instead of process-level setup.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule268PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID int
	Name     string
}

func scenario268Positive(dsn string, tenantID int) ([]Rule268PositiveRecord, error) {
	db, err := gorm.Open(sqlite.Open(dsn), &gorm.Config{})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var items []Rule268PositiveRecord
	if err := db.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Find(&items).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return items, nil
}
